title: fix: the kit repo carries its own filled rules block
headline: The kit repo carries its own filled rules block, named in a standards index, so a sweep run in the kit no longer reads the shipped template with its empty slots.
alignment: v1.51.1 is a patch before 1.51.2: K359 alone, landed first because the sweep approver reads the rules block as main has it, so 1.51.2's own sweep needs this on main.

items.text: The kit repo carries its own filled rules block in `standards/agent-team-adapter.md`, named by `standards/INDEX.md`; the shipped `rules/agent-teams.md` keeps its slots for installs to fill.
items.where: A sweep run in the kit repo
items.before: Refused: the rules block held template slots
items.after: Reads the kit's own filled block

verification: The two tests that pin the filled block and the shipped slots passed on the branch and ship with 1.51.2.

decisions.decision: Land the filled block first, as its own release
decisions.why: The approver reads the rules block as main has it, so a branch cannot fill its own reviewers' rules; the owner's pick (2026-11-23).

decisions.decision: The block takes the owner's four values
decisions.why: No named security standard; rules/security.md is the baseline; errors go to stderr with no secrets; the secret scan is secret-shapes.mjs.

upgrading: Nothing to run: the filled block lives in the kit repo only, and install does not copy it.
limits: Its two tests ship with 1.51.2, whose test check reads a docs-only test as a doc claim. The block is reviewed in 1.51.2's sweep, the first that can read it.

tests.flips: declared tests at main and on this branch; the PR run gives the final count

dimensions.name: Privacy
dimensions.result: Clean: the block names file kinds and the kit's own paths, no personal data

dimensions.name: Code security
dimensions.result: Not touched: docs only; the lead read the block against rules/security.md

dimensions.result: Its two tests move to 1.51.2, where the docs-only kind is read
